components.name: Commit Row
components.description: The atomic disclosure unit of the log: graph dot, message, mono metadata, diff-stat, expandable diff detail.
components.css: .ds-commit { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px 1fr; column-gap: 16px; position: relative; } .ds-commit__rail { position: relative; display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-commit__dot { margin-top: 0.8rem; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #3fb950; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #0b0e11; } .ds-commit__row { display: block; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: 0; padding: 0.55rem 1.9rem 0.5rem 12px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; color: #e6e8eb; font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-commit__row:hover { background: #12161c; } .ds-commit__msg { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-commit__meta { display: flex; gap: 0.6em; margin-top: 0.3em; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(230,232,235,0.58); } .ds-commit__hash { color: rgba(230,232,235,0.6); } .ds-commit__stat-add { color: #3fb950; } .ds-commit__stat-del { color: #f4858c; }

components.name: Ref Selector Trigger
components.description: The single primary navigation control; redraws the whole log in place on selection.
components.css: .ds-ref { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid rgba(230,232,235,0.18); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: rgba(230,232,235,0.6); cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; transition: border-color 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-ref:hover { background: #12161c; } .ds-ref__name { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; color: #f4858c; font-weight: 500; }

components.name: Command Menu Option
components.description: A result row inside the ⌘K dialog; icon is always a drawn SVG, never a Unicode glyph.

components.css: .ds-cmdk-opt { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 0.6rem 0.7rem; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; color: rgba(230,232,235,0.82); font-family: Archivo, sans-serif; } .ds-cmdk-opt[aria-selected='true'] { background: rgba(244,133,140,0.14); color: #e6e8eb; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(244,133,140,0.32); } .ds-cmdk-opt__glyph { flex: none; width: 22px; text-align: center; color: #f4858c; } .ds-cmdk-opt__label { flex: 1 1 auto; font-size: 13px; } .ds-cmdk-opt__meta { flex: none; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(230,232,235,0.58); }

components.css: .ds-diff { margin: 0; padding: 12px 16px; background: #07090b; border: 1px solid rgba(230,232,235,0.09); border-radius: 6px; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.75; white-space: pre-wrap; } .ds-diff__line { display: block; } .ds-diff__marker { display: inline-block; width: 1.3em; color: rgba(230,232,235,0.58); } .ds-diff__line--add .ds-diff__marker { color: #3fb950; } .ds-diff__line--add .ds-diff__text { color: rgba(230,232,235,0.82); } .ds-diff__line--untracked .ds-diff__text { color: rgba(230,232,235,0.58); text-decoration: underline dashed rgba(230,232,235,0.18); text-underline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: The site is Anuj's career rendered as a real, browsable commit log rather than a decorative metaphor: every project is a commit, every role is a merged branch, every skill surfaces as a diff line. One committed world — a near-black graphite ground read the way a repo is read, in a browser tab at a desk — with no light theme to hedge against it. The single ref selector (main / experience / about) is the entire navigation model: it redraws the same log in place rather than routing to new pages, so the whole site behaves like `git checkout <ref>`. The system is monospace-ledger-first for anything that carries a fact (hashes, dates, refs, diff stats, command labels) and humanist-sans for anything that carries a claim (commit messages, prose, notes). Depth is conveyed by graphite tonal layering, not shadows, except for two floating overlays — the ref dropdown and the ⌘K dialog — which are the only elements allowed real elevation because they visually detach from the log's flow. The pink accent (#f4858c) is a pinned carry-over from the prior VS Code-titlebar design, repurposed here to mark the HEAD/active ref exclusively — it never decorates.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-only, single committed world — no theme toggle.
Ledger monospace for metadata, humanist sans for messages and prose.
A single warm-pink accent, reserved for HEAD/active state only.
Flat, tonally-layered surfaces; shadows appear only on the two floating overlays (ref list, ⌘K dialog).
The commit log is the entire page; there is no hero image or centered name.

rules.name: The Two-Signal Rule
rules.body: Only two hues carry meaning on this site: green for shipped/ordinary, pink for HEAD/active. No third accent is introduced for any future section — a new state reuses one of these two rather than inventing a color.

rules.name: The Accent-Is-State Rule
rules.body: Pink is never decorative. Every pixel of #f4858c on the page corresponds to "this is the currently active thing" (HEAD dot, active ref, focused control, an actively-open diff's removed lines). If a future element needs pink and isn't marking active state, that's a misuse.

rules.name: The Ledger/Prose Split Rule
rules.body: If a piece of text is a fact about a commit (hash, timestamp, ref, stat count), it renders in JetBrains Mono. If it's a claim a human wrote (a commit message, a note, a prose sentence), it renders in Archivo. Never mix the two roles onto the same string.

rules.name: The Overlay-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows exist only on things that detach from the page's normal flow (dropdown, dialog, toast) or on the single HEAD-marker halo. No card, row, or button at rest carries a shadow — depth there comes from the graphite tonal steps alone.

dos: Do treat pink (#f4858c) as an active-state signal only — HEAD dot, active ref, focus, diff − lines — never as decoration.
Do render every command-palette result icon as a hand-drawn SVG matched to the header's branch/search glyph stroke weight, never a Unicode character.
Do keep every diff stat (+add/−del) sourced from real content data, never a placeholder count.

Do use --color-ink-4 (rgba(230,232,235,.58)) as the canonical quietest-text value — it was tuned during the finish-review fix round specifically to clear contrast on the graphite ground; don't substitute a dimmer ad hoc value.
Do reserve 12px radius and real box-shadow for the two floating overlays (ref dropdown, ⌘K dialog) only; everything else at rest is flat and 6px-radius.
donts: Don't add a colored border-left (or any left-edge accent stripe) to the ref selector or any other control — this was a finish-review finding, removed, and must not recur.

Don't fabricate a build/deploy step in the boot sequence that this static, no-build-step site doesn't actually perform (the shipped boot copy — clone, push to main, open the live URL — describes only real, literal actions).
Don't introduce a third accent hue; the system is a strict two-signal palette (green = shipped, pink = active).
Don't add drop shadows to commit rows, buttons, or any element at rest — depth here comes from graphite tonal layering, not shadow.
